observed.label: Observed
observed.hint: Measured or reanalysis values for past dates.

climatology.label: Climatology
climatology.hint: Long-term average for this calendar day — an estimate, not a forecast.

modelled.label: Modelled
modelled.hint: Gridded model estimate (e.g. SoilGrids, 250 m) — not a lab test.

simulated.label: Simulated
simulated.hint: Visual effect only — not based on observations.

model_output.label: Model estimate
model_output.hint: Output of Bhoomi's transparent crop-development model.

landing.title: Know your land. Grow with confidence.
landing.subtitle: Map your fields, read the weather and soil around them, plan your crop stage by stage — and watch it grow in a living virtual field.
landing.howTitle: A field companion that is honest about what it knows
landing.howBody: Bhoomi combines satellite maps, weather forecasts and soil estimates with transparent crop models. Every number shows where it came from.

map.title: Draw your fields
map.body: Outline each field on satellite imagery. Area, perimeter and centre are calculated geodesically on the server.

environment.title: Weather & soil
environment.body: Current conditions, 16-day forecast, rainfall, wind and gridded soil estimates — each with its source.

plan.title: Crop plans
plan.body: Choose a crop and variety. Get stage dates as ranges, with irrigation, nutrient and scouting reminders.

field.title: A living field
field.body: Scroll through the season and watch your paddy grow from seedling to golden harvest, day and night.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.body: Questions about this week's work, grounded in your field's data — with sources and clear uncertainty.

honest.title: No invented data
honest.body: Observed, forecast, climatology and model output are always labelled. Simulations are never presented as observations.

landing.trustTitle: Every value tells you what it is
landing.trustBody: Farming decisions need honest information. Bhoomi labels each piece of data so you know how much to rely on it.
landing.footer: Weather: Open-Meteo · Soil: ISRIC SoilGrids · Maps: Esri, OpenStreetMap

scene.subtitle: Watch a paddy season unfold, from flooded seedlings to golden harvest. The same crop model plans your own field.
scene.note: Illustration of a typical Kuruvai season, not live data.

onboarding.regionHint: Used for local seasons and crop calendars. You can change it later.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's what's happening across your fields.

dashboard.noCycles: No active crops. Plan one from any field.

tasks.title: Tasks

tasks.noPlansBody: Tasks are created from crop plans. Start a plan to get a season's reminders.

timeline.label: Crop season timeline. Use arrow keys to move by a day, Shift+arrow for a week.

map.noGeolocation: Location isn't available on this device.

map.drawStep2: Tap the first point again (or double-tap) to close the shape.
map.drawStep3: Drag the points to adjust, then name and save.
map.editHint: Drag corners to adjust. Tap a mid-point to add a corner; right-click a corner to remove it.
map.disclaimer: This boundary is your own drawing on imagery. It is not a legal or cadastral survey and may differ from official land records.
map.noFields: No fields yet. Draw one to begin.
map.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}"? Its crop history is kept but the field will be hidden.
map.cannotEdit: This boundary can't be edited here. Try redrawing it.

geomErrors.not_polygon: The shape must be a single polygon.
geomErrors.invalid_geometry: The boundary crosses itself. Move the corners so edges don't overlap.
geomErrors.too_small: This area is too small (under 10 m²).
geomErrors.too_large: This area is too large for one field (over 10 km²). Split it into several fields.

land.terrainNote: From a 90 m elevation model — approximate; small fields may show no slope.
land.noCycles: No crop plans for this field yet.

env.title: Weather & soil

env.alertsNote: Generated from forecast thresholds by Bhoomi. These are not official IMD warnings.

soil.griddedNote: Modelled estimate on a 250 m grid — not a lab test of your field.
soil.noData: No soil estimate is available for this location.
soil.testsNote: Lab results (e.g. Soil Health Card) take priority over gridded estimates.
soil.addTestBody: Enter values from your lab report. Leave unknown values blank.
soil.noTestsBody: Adding a lab result makes crop and nutrient guidance more reliable.

discover.title: Crops for this field
discover.subtitle: Ranked by season, climate, soil and water — with reasons and limitations.
discover.note: A starting point, not a prescription. Check with your local agriculture office.
discover.noneBody: We couldn't score crops for this field. Try another date.

confidence.data_backedHint: Supported by regional crop calendars and this field's data.
confidence.preliminaryHint: Based on general ranges; local guidance not yet curated.
